settings_general_agent_hooks_install_omp: Install omp, Claude Code or Codex and they show up here, ready to connect.
settings_general_config_the_running_stac: The running stack still uses the old config.
settings_general_dock_a_small_pill_that_: A small pill that floats above your other apps. Press the hotkey from anywhere to message an agent; it works with the Atlas window closed.
settings_general_dock_keep_the_pill_on_s: Keep the pill on screen while Atlas runs. Hide it any time with the hide key, the pill's hide button or right-click menu, or the tray menu; the choice is remembered.
settings_general_dock_opens_the_dock_s_c: Opens the dock's composer from any app. The text goes to the agent you last used, or the one you @mention.
settings_general_dock_works_even_while_t: Works even while the dock is hidden, so it is always the way back. The tray menu has Show Agent Dock too.
settings_general_git_none_of_writernames: None of {writerNames} is installed on this computer, so there is nothing to write messages yet. Install one and pick it here.
settings_general_git_the_staged_diff_all: The staged diff (all changes when nothing is staged) goes only to the agent you pick here, run on this computer with no tools, plus your recent commit subjects and the commit rules of CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md. Files that look like secrets (.env, keys, certificates) are never sent; lockfiles and binaries are sent as names only. Choose {@settings_general_git_option_off} to hide the button.
settings_general_hygiene_group_agents_le: Agents leave browsers, dev servers and caches behind. Fix ends only processes Atlas tagged whose owner is gone, and frees only folders Atlas registered. target/, node_modules and worktrees are never removed.
settings_general_notification_a_system_n: A system notification when an agent is done or is waiting for an answer.
settings_general_notification_add_a_shor: Add a short sound to each notification.
settings_general_notification_atlas_tell: Atlas tells you when an agent finishes or needs you.
settings_general_notification_skip_the_n: Skip the notification when that worktree is the one on your screen.
settings_general_shell_links_services_st: Services start with the PATH and variables of this shell, the same as in your terminal. Pick another shell if tools like bun or node are not found.
settings_general_shortcut_click_then_pre: Click, then press the new shortcut
settings_general_shortcut_if_you_pick_a_: If you pick a shortcut that another command already uses, that command loses it.
settings_general_sound_master_switch_for: Master switch for every Atlas sound.
settings_general_sound_on_top_of_your_sy: On top of your system's volume, which always wins.
settings_general_sound_only_the_ones_tha: Only the ones that need your attention, and quieter.
settings_general_sound_play_user_interfa: “Play user interface sound effects” is off in System Settings ▸ Sound, so Atlas stays silent. The Play buttons below still work.
settings_general_sound_short_quiet_cues_: Short, quiet cues for the moments that matter: a stack coming up, a service failing, an agent needing you. Nothing plays on ordinary clicks.
settings_general_sound_switch_any_of_the: Switch any of them off on its own.
settings_general_workspace_added_in_fron: Added in front of every branch Atlas creates, such as your-name/fix-login.
settings_general_workspace_atlas_never_r: Atlas never removes a worktree with unsaved changes or commits that are not on a remote, and keeps its branch.
settings_general_workspace_checked_every: Checked every 15 minutes. Pinned worktrees and the one you are viewing are skipped.
settings_general_workspace_days_without_: Days without agent activity before a worktree is removed.
settings_general_workspace_linked_worktr: Linked worktrees take disk space. Scan to see how big each one is, its last commit and whether it has unsaved work.
settings_general_workspace_no_linked_wor: No linked worktrees yet. Create one from the sidebar and it will show up here.
settings_general_workspace_put_each_work: Put each worktree in a folder named after its repository, so projects do not mix.
settings_general_workspace_text_to_put_b: Text to put before each new branch name.
settings_general_workspace_tick_the_ones: Tick the ones you no longer need, then delete them.
settings_general_workspace_where_atlas_c: Where Atlas creates checkouts. Leave empty to use ~/.atlas/worktrees.
